margin_floor_rationale: Measured PyTorch-versus-ONNX-Runtime embedding noise reaches about 3e-4 per component and about 1.3e-4 in cosine score, so reference decisions closer than 5e-4 are knife edges that a different float32 backend may flip without being wrong.

find-witness: Find a witness before pressing the petition further.
Write down the disputed account and seek someone who observed it.
let-rest: Let the matter rest unless the facts change.
No further step is advised on the present account.
propose-settlement: Put a practical settlement to both parties and record what each accepts.
Propose terms both parties can keep, then write them into the ledger.
refer-higher: Refer the petition to a higher authority. The fly offers no final judgment.
Place the matter before a higher authority under the fictional charter.
request-return: Ask for the return of {subject}. Record the request and any reply.
Request that {subject} be returned before taking a further step.
seek-full-reparation: Preserve the account of harm to {subject}. Seek full reparation under the fictional charter.
Record the loss involving {subject} and request full reparation.
seek-small-reparation: First speak with the other party. Record the harm to {subject}. Seek modest reparation if it continues.
Document the harm to {subject}, then ask for a small reparation.
sworn-account: Request a sworn account under the fictional village charter.
Ask each party for a sworn account within the fictional charter.
